nom: FARMACY Filling Good Hyaluronic Acid Plumping Serum

avis.texte: I really endeavored to love this line of products. I purchased this, the toner, and the buttery moisturizer. All was going well for the first several applications but over time, I noticed that my facial piercings (nostrils specifically) had a very funky odor. I'm not new to the piercing game and I do realize that all piercings can have a general weird smell from time to time but this was advanced weirdness. I had thought that my nostril piercings of 10+ years were becoming infected but once I skipped a few days of this routine the smell wasn't there anymore. I used it again a few more days after that break and the smell came back. I don't think this is a bad product. My skin generally enjoyed it but the funk alone was enough to make me not want to use it anymore.

This serum is great for dry skin. It keeps my skin smooth and hydrated even on the coldest days. I am, however, not a huge fan of the smell. There is a strong honey smell, which I should have expected, but, thankfully, the smell goes away after a minute or so. In my opinion, the benefits of the serum outweigh the unpleasant smell. If you're sensitive to smell, or you're not a fan of the smell of honey, you might want to give it a whiff in the store before buying.

This serum is shper hydrating. Leaves my skin looking refreshed and flawless. I have sensitve skin dry skin so a lot of products dont work for me. Prior to trying Farmacy i was gonna go to the dermatoligist to get recommended what products to use and know i dont have to this works amazing.

I've used this serum all year, repurchased it twice already, and am about to repurchase a third bottle. This serum has done so much for my skin and is so hydrating that I no longer have to use additional hydrating products. For that reason, I can justify the price, but with that being said, I wish the price was a little less expensive. Especially since the bottle doesn't last very long if using one full pump twice daily. Still an amazing product, and I will be repurchasing it for life. This product is perfect for those in a dry climate like myself.

I LOVE this serum and have now bought almost every product from this brand, and could not be happier! I used to use much more expensive products, and feel these actually deliver. My skin is notably hydrated and plumper, and this works great under makeup too.
I can actually see the wrinkles in my forehead going away just after a few uses! Also it just feels amazing going on your skin!! I love love love it and is 100% worth the price

avis.titre: I like it with a caveat
avis.texte: It sinks in well, and it smells divine, but it pills and I despise prodcuts that pill. I only used this after cleansing so it's this product causing it (ie, nothign else is contributing to it or mixing with it) So, if you rub against your clothes or touch your face thorughout the day, you may definitely see those while pilling particles. I'm not sure if they would go away if you put on another mostiruzer on top. I typically avoid any products that pill on their own as I do not want to adjust my regimen to avoid pilling but still want to use the product. The product needs to work for me, not the other way around.
